title: artemisia campestris var. pubescens
intro: Artemisia campestris var. pubescens, commonly known as Woolly Mugwort, is a plant species belonging to the daisy family and is native to North America. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat a range of health issues, with its health benefits including the relief of menstrual cramps, reduction of fever, and alleviation of digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Woolly Mugwort include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antimicrobial properties, making it a versatile remedy for various ailments. The plant's bioactive constituents include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource in traditional herbalism.
